categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Everfine Photoelectric Information Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent detection and recognition information systems and services. Its main business segments include intelligent photoelectric detection information systems, intelligent detection information services, driving training information systems and services, financial biometric recognition information systems, and identity recognition information systems. The company serves industries such as display, automotive, lighting, medical devices, finance, smart transportation, electronics, photovoltaics, and charging piles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced photoelectric detection technologies including spectrometers, integrating spheres, photometers, radiation safety detection, flicker and glare detection, automotive lighting detection, display detection, brightness meters, OLED industry-specific detection, spectral colorimeters, standard light sources, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) testing systems. It employs R&D-driven manufacturing with a market-oriented, sales-driven production model emphasizing customized, high-precision, and intelligent detection equipment. The company also develops software and integrated systems for measurement and calibration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include mainstream panel manufacturers, automotive manufacturers, third-party testing institutions, financial institutions such as banks, driving training organizations, and government quality inspection agencies. The company’s products and services are widely used in display, automotive lighting, smart transportation, finance, medical devices, and lighting industries. Its smart driving training systems cover over 100 cities across 28 provinces in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and multiple subsidiaries located in Hangzhou and other Chinese cities. It also has wholly owned subsidiaries in the United States (METRUE INC.) and Hong Kong (Tianmi Technology Co., Ltd.). Its products are exported to developed regions including the United States, Europe, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hangzhou Everfine operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of intelligent detection equipment and systems. It provides integrated detection solutions and services to end customers and third-party testing organizations, positioning itself as a technology and solution provider rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high R&D investment (over 23% of revenue) focusing on new technologies such as new automotive lighting measurement systems, scanning light field radiation measurement, transient light modulation and radiation safety, new display detection equipment, high-precision power analysis, EMC testing systems, metal material testing for new energy vehicles, and medical optical performance testing. It emphasizes innovation, standard-setting leadership, and expanding into strategic emerging application areas while strengthening talent development and flexible manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of intelligent detection equipment, customized system solutions, and related services including calibration, product testing, certification, and software services. The company also earns income from driving training information systems and financial biometric recognition products. Sales are mainly conducted via direct sales channels with some distribution. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the intelligent detection and recognition equipment industry, holding a dominant market share especially in lighting detection (over 60%) and smart driving training systems. It is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise with numerous patents and industry awards. Its products have international competitiveness and are used by thousands of enterprises and government agencies. The company actively participates in national and international standards development, reinforcing its industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 436 million, a 3.42% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 92.36 million, a slight decrease of 1.13%. Total assets were about RMB 1.7 billion with a low debt ratio of 8.3%. The company maintains stable profitability and cash flow, with consistent high R&D investment and a steady dividend payout policy. It has expanded its business scale through new subsidiaries and internal growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, high-quality, and technologically advanced intelligent detection systems tailored to customer needs. It differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, a broad and diversified product portfolio, and leadership in industry standards. Its products support domestic substitution of imported equipment, especially in strategic sectors like new displays and automotive lighting. The company also offers integrated solutions and comprehensive services, enhancing customer satisfaction and building a strong brand reputation.
